title: PCRAM Source Snapshot
description: Schema for local-only PCRAM source snapshots used in the regulatory intelligence lab.

snapshot_id.description: Unique local identifier for this snapshot.

source_id.description: Stable identifier of the source definition.

source_type.description: Category of source monitored by the lab.

source_url.description: Canonical source URL reference. Kept as metadata only in P0.

captured_by.description: Actor or tool that created the snapshot.

capture_method.description: Local capture method used in the lab.

content_hash.description: Deterministic hash of normalized content (recommended SHA-256 hex).

raw_text_path.description: Relative path to local raw text artifact.

normalized_payload.description: Structured normalized payload for downstream delta analysis.
